meta.question: E38 found folding ~neutral under the ENCOUNTER model (dR=1.04) because it SATURATES (2.3M candidates). The E39 explicit OH+deoxyribose channel does NOT saturate (~400-1700 reactions), so folding might be a real lever again. Does realistic chromatin folding change the ratio under the FAITHFUL explicit reaction model — and does the faithful model land in PARTRAC's band?
meta.method: The full explicit channel needs the worker's IRT competition, but folded chromatin packs ~27x more bp/length -> ~100M backbone atoms, infeasible in the worker. So the competition is REPLAYED OFFLINE: the worker exports per-OH (x,y,z,t_birth,t_death) via collectOHrec (pure-radical death times, explicitDna off); the scorer damages a sugar iff t_birth + sampleIRT_type0(r0) < t_death (the OH reaches the sugar before its radical death) — the same first-passage the worker uses (sigma=0.15nm from k=2.5e9 Buxton). Scored against LINE/BUNDLE/SOLENOID on identical 7x7 axes core (E37 fold-in-place, +-400nm) + a full 21x21 straight-grid control at the FULL fibre length (+-1500nm). RNG reset per geometry -> reproducible paired fold comparison. Removing the ~0.017% OH-sugar reactions offline perturbs the radical death times negligibly.

findings: The Geant4-faithful explicit OH+deoxyribose channel, at the PRODUCTION energy (10 keV) with a complete nearest-sugar search, gives ratio 2.17 — SQUARELY IN PARTRAC's 2-3 band, parameter-free. The ratio rises with energy (1.43 -> 1.57 -> 2.17 over 1-10 keV). The encounter proxy's out-of-band 5.74 was entirely an over-counting artifact.

Realistic chromatin folding is a SECOND-ORDER lever under the explicit channel (dR 0.83-1.16): it raises the ratio at low energy and lowers it ~17% at the production energy, but keeps it IN/NEAR band throughout — folded chromatin at 10 keV = 2.17 (in band). Girth (30nm bundle) raises the ratio at low E and is neutral at high E; winding consistently lowers it ~15%.

The replay reproduces E37's survival-model dR=0.716 exactly, validating the pipeline. The indirect MODEL (encounter 5.74 vs explicit ~1.7-2.2) is the dominant ~3x lever; geometry is second-order (dR~0.8-1.2). E34's 'geometry keystone' is fully closed.
interpretation: This completes the E37-E40 arc and resolves the out-of-band mystery. The production ratio's excess (5.74 vs the 2-3 band) was NOT geometry and NOT real physics — it was the encounter proxy scoring every near-backbone OH regardless of whether it reacted with the sugar. Making the deoxyribose an explicit competing IRT reactant (Geant4-DNA molecularDNA structure) brings the ratio to 2.17 at the production energy — IN BAND, parameter-free — and realistic chromatin folding keeps it in band. The damage layer now matches Geant4/PARTRAC at the mechanism level, not by tuning.
caveats: Offline replay of the competition (justified: OH-sugar reactions are ~0.017% of all reactions, so removing them perturbs radical death times negligibly; the survival replay reproduces E37 exactly as a check).

The worker's on-line explicit search (+-2bp single fibre) under-counts vs the complete global-nearest search (1.66 vs 2.17) — the on-line dnaReactQuery should be widened to a full nearest-sugar search to match; that is an implementation refinement, not a physics change.
